verdict.rationale: Asaas offers billing automations such as charges, notifications and invoices, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents any of it. Restoring individual payments or undoing receipt confirmations concerns payment records, not automation definitions. The MCP 'branch' parameter selects a documentation branch, not an automation version.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
